data.question: Do I need technical skills?
data.answer: **No**. The core system works with simple copy-paste or file uploads on any AI platform. There are advanced options for power users, but they're optional.

data.question: Which AI platforms does this work with?
data.answer: `ChatGPT`, `Claude`, `Claude Code`, `Gemini`, `DeepSeek`, `NotebookLM`. Any AI that accepts custom instructions or file uploads.

data.question: How long does setup take?
data.answer: Basic setup: **2-3 hours**. Advanced `MCP` implementation: **a weekend**. You'll earn that time back quickly.

data.question: Will this work for my niche or industry?
data.answer: Yes. The system analyzes your writing samples, so it works regardless of your topic, industry, or content type.

data.question: What if I don't have many writing samples?
data.answer: Start with what you have. Even a **handful of pieces** is enough to get started. You can add more over time, and the system improves as you use it.

data.question: Is this just better prompts?
data.answer: No. This is a complete system for training AI to understand you: your voice, style, strategy, business, and audience. Prompts are included, but they're just one piece.

data.question: Do I get updates?
data.answer: Yes. You get access to the [private community](/product/knowii-community) where I share updates as the guide evolves.

data.question: Can I get help if I'm stuck?
data.answer: Yes. Private community access is included for questions and knowledge sharing.

data.question: Can this help with more than writing?
data.answer: Yes. Once AI knows your voice and business, it helps with podcast scripts, branding feedback, product brainstorming, marketing copy, ads, and more.

data.question: Is this the launch price?
data.answer: Yes. The price will increase as I add more content and techniques to the guide.

data.question: How is this different from other AI writing guides?
data.answer: Most guides give you prompts. Prompts work once. This gives you a complete system that evolves over time. You capture your voice, document your strategy, add business context, and build an AI that understands you.

data.question: What results can I expect?
data.answer: Day 1: first draft that sounds like you. Week 1: full system configured and working. Month 1: faster content creation with minimal editing. Month 3+: AI becomes a real creative partner.
